newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Parkway eases, more block trades seen.
newsitem.headline: Parkway eases, more block trades seen.

text.p: Shares in healthcare group Parkway Holdings Ltd fell 4.4 percent, or 30 cents, to Singapore $6.60 in moderately active trade on Thursday morning.
At 0400 GMT, the shares were being quoted at S$6.55/S$6.60. Volume was about 725,000 shares, including two block trades amounting to 334,000 shares.
Dealers said 254,000 shares were crossed at S$6.90 and another 84,000 at S$6.875.
"Parkway directors have been selling their shares so this could be more of the same. It does not look like the share price is going much higher than S$7," said a broker with a local firm.
Parkway shares have been active in recent sessions on speculation that the company would be taken over by property group DBS Land.
DBS Land has agreed to buy a 19.2 percent stake in Parkway and indicated it was interested in acquiring more shares.
